Latin word

grātiōsus

grātiōsus, grātiōsa, grātiōsum

adjective; popular with someone, grātiōsus apud aliquem · Declension on Wiktionary

influential, in favour; popular, well liked, in favour (of a person)

In this lexicon

  • influence

    also used · classical · Traupman 154, 156; Traupman 332

  • popular

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 3.58: apud omnēs ōrdinēs grātiōsus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 156, 363: popular, grātiōsus; to be popular with someone, grātiōsus esse apud aliquem

    nothing is so popular as kindnessCic. Lig. 37

    he is popular with everyoneTraupman 156

    In the entry for popular
